question: How are undergraduate B.E. and B.Tech admissions conducted at CIT?
expected_answer: Undergraduate admissions for B.E. and B.Tech are conducted through the Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA) single-window counseling system organized by DOTE.

question: What is the National Resource Centre for Structural Engineering at CIT?
expected_answer: The NRC for Structural Engineering at CIT was established with the support of the Ministry of Education to conduct ARPIT programs, advanced structural research, and digital content creation.
positive_passage_text:
[2.2 National Resource Centre (NRC)  -  Structural Engineering]
Source: National Resource Centre (NRC) URL: https://cit.edu.in/others/nrc The page describes the National Resource Centre (NRC) for Structural Engineering at CIT as a national-level platform for advanced academic engagement, capacity building and applied research. It states that the centre was established with the support of the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Objectives stated: - Knowledge sharing on structural analysis, design methodologies and construction materials. - Faculty capacity building through Annual Refresher Programmes in Teaching (ARPIT), faculty development programmes and domain-specific training workshops. - Awareness of updated Indian Standards (IS codes) and internationally accepted design practices. - Development of digital learning resources, recorded lectures and online modules. Focus areas stated: - High-performance, self-compacting and advanced concrete materials - Earthquake engineering, seismic assessment and retrofitting techniques - Steel - concrete composite systems for modern infrastructure - Smart materials, sensors and structural health monitoring systems - Sustainable construction practices and life-cycle assessment - Computational mechanics, including finite element modeling and AI-based structural performance prediction Facilities/resources stated: - Structural Engineering Laboratory, equipped with high-capacity loading systems and advanced testing instruments. - Digital Content Development Facility for recording online courses, expert lectures and interactive webinars. - High-Performance Computing Facilities with access to STAAD, SAP2000, ANSYS and ABAQUS. - Library resources including national and international journals, reference books and updated design standards.
